mentions.note: Fantastic brands complement Kimberly-Clark's portfolio despite Tylenol-related regulatory noise weighing on the stock.
Litigation manageable and similar to Johnson & Johnson history; long-term shareholders should be fine—good situation, not bad.
Price was depressed by RFK Jr.'s unproven Tylenol-autism claims, letting Kimberly-Clark acquire it at what Cramer calls a bargain.
